name: keepers_are_ranked_by_flash_then_capacity
description: Keepers store the mesh's records, so room to store them ranks first: a device with flash is qualified for the job in a way a fast one without it is not. Capacity breaks the tie, because a keeper also answers pulls and a device already struggling to render should not also be serving state. There is no election protocol at all - the ranking is a pure function of the peer table, so every device reaches the same answer independently and no messages are exchanged.

steps.description: most flash first, then most capacity
